title: ✨ “In every sunrise, God paints a reminder that love never fades — it only shines brighter in heaven.”
paragraphs: ✨ “In every sunrise, God paints a reminder that love never fades — it only shines brighter in heaven.”

Today we celebrate Shiela’s birthday — a life filled with grace, kindness, and faith.
Though her beloved husband (my cousin Boyet) now rests with the Lord, their story of love continues to inspire us to pray, to hope, and to believe that heaven is never far away. 💛
🌿 “The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.” – Psalm 34 : 18
🙏 May this day be a prayer of gratitude and peace — a celebration of life, love, and God’s eternal promise.
